notes: CPU percent uses one logical CPU as 100%; no GPU utilization is inferred.
Capped at 60 fps. CPU savings are not FPS gains.
Initial control-1/states-1 timings quarantined due concurrent external builds; fence-1 interrupted and omitted.
Two early clean trials used harness wall-clock CPU intervals and post-hoc validity audits; later trials use monotonic CPU intervals and explicit validity.
Runtime counters are latest periodic/sparse observations, not exact exit totals.
The 313195a to 0080b5b fixture-only pin change did not change the executable bytes.
